## Descripción
A message has been encrypted using RSA. The public key is gone… but someone might have been careless with the private key. Can you recover it and decrypt the message? Download the [flag](https://challenge-files.cylabacademy.net/library/f237dbe3d9649dccd19ec1ae56a3380afa24e1960376a1b9c59cbb234ac22ef5/flag.enc) and [image](https://challenge-files.cylabacademy.net/library/f237dbe3d9649dccd19ec1ae56a3380afa24e1960376a1b9c59cbb234ac22ef5/image.jpg).

Hints

1

Metadata can tell you more than you expect.

2

Hex can be turned back into a key file.
## Solución
